caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick rendered in pencil or graphite on a beige background. The candlestick stands upright in the center of the composition and is shown in full detail, with a wide, rounded base that tapers upward into a narrower central stem and flares out slightly again at the top where the candle would be placed. The body of the candlestick features several curved sections and stepped details, giving it a classical and symmetrical appearance. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset sketch of the same candlestick, providing a schematic outline view with dimensions noted as 6 1/4 inches in height and 2 1/8 inches in width. The artist’s name appears handwritten near the lower right area of the drawing. The entire composition is executed in shades of gray, showing careful shading to indicate the roundness and metallic texture of the candlestick, with no additional objects or background details present.
title: Candlestick
